frequency_question: How often do major national union coalitions follow through on strike ultimatums within the specified timeframe rather than settling beforehand?
membership_rule: Includes national-level federation strike calls with formal deadlines issued by recognized labor alliances; excludes localized single-firm wildcat strikes or threats without explicit operational timelines.
